senses.gloss: m. (b. h.) gold, gold coin, v. דִּינָר.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 92b:12">Snh. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>יוצק ז׳ רותח וכ׳</he> molten gold be poured into &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 33:5">Ex. R. s. 33</cite> <he>מכל עשרך … ושל ז׳</he> than all thy (Korah’s) wealth of silver and gold; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:1">B. Mets. IV, 1</cite> <he>הז׳ קונה את הכסף וכ׳</he> the delivery of gold coin effects the purchase of silver &c., i.e. in an exchange of coined gold for silver &c., the superior metal is the merchandise and the inferior the money; Y. ed. <he>הכסף קונה את הז׳</he>; v. Bab. ib. 44ᵃ; a. fr.—Pl. <he>זְהָבִים</he>, <he>זְהָבִין</he>.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35:6">Ex. R. s. 35</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:10:4">Cant. R. to III, 10</cite> <he>שבעה</he> (<he>מיני</he>) <he>ז׳ וכ׳</he> seven kinds of gold were used in the Temple.
<cite ref="Yoma 44b:17">Yoma 44ᵇ</cite> <he>שבעה ז׳ וכ׳</he> there are seven &c.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 53b">Erub. 53ᵇ</cite> (in allegorical speech) <he>והרקיעו לז׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ארקיעו</he>) make the gold (glowing coals) sky-blue (fan them so as to give blue flames) and prepare for me two tellers in the dark (cocks).
